About.title: About Islamic School Finder
About.intro: We help families find, compare and contact Islamic schools around the world, with clear and honest information.

sections.p: Every school has one profile with its curriculum, Quran and Arabic programmes, fees, facilities and admissions. Profiles are available in English, Arabic and Malay.

Each profile shows a verification level, from community added to school managed, so you can see how far the details have been checked. Schools can claim their profile and keep it up to date; changes to important details are reviewed by our team before they appear.
We do not rank schools by quality. When you tell us what matters to your family, we show how many of your preferences each school meets, and which ones, so you can decide for yourself.

Contact.title: Contact us
Contact.intro: Questions, corrections or suggestions? We would like to hear from you.

sections.p: If you notice something wrong on a school's page, or a school is missing, write to us with the school's name and city.
You can download or delete your own data from your account page. For anything else about your data, email us.

Contact.claimHint: Do you work at a school?

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: We collect as little personal information as we can. This page explains what we hold and why. (Draft notice: have it reviewed by a lawyer for your country before launch.)

sections.p: You can browse, search and compare schools without an account. Your compare list is kept only in your own browser. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

If you create an account we store your name, email address and the claims you send. We use essential cookies to keep you signed in. Staff and school representatives are also recorded in an audit log when they change information.
To stop abuse we briefly count requests per internet address and per account, for example sign-in attempts. These counters are deleted after a day. Our servers keep short-lived technical logs.
Our hosting and database providers process data on our behalf. School pages may show a map from OpenStreetMap, which then receives your internet address like any website you visit.
We do not ask for information about children. Accounts are for parents, guardians and school staff.
You can download all the data linked to your account, or permanently delete your account, from the account page. You can also ask us to correct or erase data by email.
